item: row 264: a request that meets a store switch is refused with its words, not a 500
refs: PR #2226; row 264; row 271; follows row 256 (R702 part 2)
summary: LaneSwapping (an open that waited past SWAP_WAIT_S during a store's switch) now answers a route with 409 and the fixed SWAPPING_WORDS, no traceback; a background job whose failure is or was raised from it records exactly those words and logs one line (from None opts out); callers that catch it themselves are unchanged. Release line: If a page or background task tries to read a separate store while it is being switched for its rebuilt copy, it now says so and asks you to try again, instead of reporting an internal error. Row 271: the switch counted a connection freed with no close event (its id later reused, measured as a deque), so a rebuild was refused with connections still open when none were; the count now holds a weak reference to each pool record and drops an entry only when it is known dead (record gone, or holding another connection), and still counts anything uncertain, including a detached connection. Release line: A store rebuild could be refused with connections still open when none were; it no longer is, and a connection that may still be open is always counted.
